+## The change: tools that need an unlinked connector
+When a request arrives, a listed tool is left out of its catalog if its own description says, within one sentence,
+that it needs or requires a connector, integration or connection to be linked, connected, set up or authorised (for
+example "Needs the Asana connector to be linked in Settings.").

+without negating it, that this app is linked or connected, the tool stays.
+Lane routing and every menu the model sees then use the tools that remain. Each of them keeps its name,
+description, schema and order. The model still chooses freely among them, including choosing no tool. The harness

I4 derived-value authority: A previous model's derived ledger is presented to the deciding model as already resolving every entry, with a directive to take its NOW or DATED value; it is not advisory (app/agent.py:142, app/agent.py:172, app/short.py:251).
Source-review evidence retained on an admitted submission

RELEASE under policy v13. Operator guidance from Peyton, 2026-10-29: precedent october-29-reused-draft-no-disagree-clause (PR #3270), and lean permissive on gray areas. The hold was l2-model-inconclusive with no verified finding. Every L1 concern note was I5 routed guidance at app/guide_records.py:25,38,61, app/guide_tools.py:3 and app/records.py:131. guide_records.py, guide_tools.py and records.py are byte-identical to released dan0l v28 b4b99c40 (SHA de97219a…b792; first exact-SHA public handoff 2026-10-28T21:05:43Z, before this upload at 2026-10-29T09:46:50Z). That guidance passes the model guidance only and the model writes the graded value, so the leads are refuted under the routed-guidance safe harbor; the same reading was applied in the crown-v194 release. Diff against v28: 29 runtime files identical, own runtime changes in 5 (app/short.py, app/agent.py, app/llm.py, app/config.py, app/memory/final_check.py), so this is not an unmodified fork. (1) Earlier reply as a note, app/short.py:245-275: the key is the normalized user id plus system text, shown notes and asked part. On a hit, earlier[0] goes only into SHARED_REPLY_NOTE prompt text ("the notes and the message decide wherever they differ"), and decide() at short.py:275 always makes a fresh deciding call over the full req.user_input. earlier[1] (the answer) is never used. No host compare, retry, overwrite or substitution. Outcome is fresh per request (agent.py:121). If the deciding call fails, it falls through to the full records lane (agent.py:144-155) and never ships the earlier reply. This is the permitted prompt-only reuse in the 10-29 precedent, and it fixes the horizon v3 cache-hit I1/I4 reject (no deciding call). (2) Final check, final_check.py:3: a prompt-only wording change asking the model to keep its ANSWER line. records.py:488-493, identical to v28, ships the model's reply and keeps the earlier one only if the new reply is empty (shape recovery). (3) Currency rule PROGRAM_CURRENCY at short.py:29-30 and filing-date order at short.py:225-233 fall under the case-file currency safe harbor; v28's host change-cue reorder was removed. (4) Retry and timeout changes at llm.py:277-280 and config.py:30 are reliability only. Unreleased-source check: unreleased dan0l v29 336015f5 and v30 95534e25 had no public handoff by the upload time. Neither contains any v5 delta (SHARED_REPLY_NOTE, PROGRAM_CURRENCY, the ANSWER-line wording or the 60 s timeout all absent), and v5 diverges from both in 16 files. Not found in tensorworker v19 either.
Source-review evidence retained on an admitted submission
